gloss: to set up; to install; to establish

definitions.gloss: to install; to set up (equipment or facilities)
definitions.explanation: To put physical equipment, devices, or facilities in place for use.

definitions.gloss: to establish; to set up (an organization or committee)
definitions.explanation: To formally create or establish an organization, committee, or similar body.

examples.english: New benches were installed in the park.

examples.english: The government set up a specialist team to investigate the problem.

notes:
Used for both physical installation (cameras, equipment, signs) and abstract establishment (committees, organizations, systems). The passive form {設置|せっち}される is very common in news and official announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設置場所|せっちばしょ}: installation location
- {設置工事|せっちこうじ}: installation work
- {設置基準|せっちきじゅん}: installation standards
- {設置者|せっちしゃ}: installer; establishing party
- ⟦{常設|じょうせつ}→常設：16764_jousetsu⟧: permanently installed/established

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}ける→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧: to install; to attach — more hands-on, physical installation of smaller items
- ⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish; to found — used for organizations and companies, not physical objects
- ⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put; to place — general placement, not formal installation
